profile.headline: Senior Software Development Manager
profile.summary: Senior Engineering Manager / Director with 15+ years of experience leading and scaling global development teams. Delivered enterprise-scale solutions and brought new products to market through Agile transformations that boosted efficiency by 10% and the cultivation of high-performing, global teams.

positions.title: Senior Manager / Director
positions.description:
•	Led three globally distributed software development teams (Platform, Requirements, and Configurations teams - 82 engineers/managers) in the delivery of enterprise solutions, aligning development with strategic business goals.
o	Drove product strategy and roadmap alignment with cross-functional leadership, resulting in faster time to market and improved product market fit.
o	Streamlined the tracking process and created cross-team dashboards to reduce critical customer escalation times by 15% during a major product re-architecting to Microservices.
o	Involved in all levels of the 3-tier architecture: Browser frontend, WebSphere/Apache application servers, and Oracle/DB2/SQL Server databases.
•	Technical lead and manager of the performance engineering team (13 engineers in the US, UK, and India).
o	Collaborated with DevOps to improve the deployment, performance, and accuracy of the automated performance test suites.
o	Successfully integrated performance tests within the CI/CD pipeline (2 builds per day).
o	Worked closely with development teams to define performance objectives early in the development plan.
•	Led Agile/Scrum transformation across four development teams, standardizing processes and boosting engineering efficiency 10% based on story point throughput.
•	Initiated sharing of testing environments, scripts, and automation between system testing and performance testing teams, which decreased system test deployment time by 50% and also increased performance test coverage by 10%.
•	Elevated team engagement and performance by implementing a structured quarterly review and mentorship program for first-line managers and key lead engineers.
•	Drove a high-performance culture by implementing new pair programming practices, which led to a 10% reduction in production defects.
positions.insights: Enterprise Software, Software Project Management and +31 skills

positions.title: Senior Manager/Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Spearheaded the development and launch of a new, centralized configuration management offering for IBM ELM products, overcoming integration complexities to unify configurations from requirements to testing that is used today by the largest and most demanding customers of the IBM ELM suite.
•	Formed and led a multi-national engineering team (Israel, Japan, and the US) to build a new product lifecycle management and reporting tool.
•	Managed a large System Verification Testing team (40 test engineers and 3 managers)
positions.insights: Enterprise Software, Quality Control and +33 skills

positions.title: Manager/Technical Lead
positions.description: •	Established a successful remote development lab in India, building a new team to manage the launch and ongoing development of a new web-based change management tool.
positions.insights: Problem Solving, Team Leadership and +10 skills
